0022600165.text: The 2-4 New Orleans Pelicans, who have won two straight after losing their first two road games, are 11th in the West and 4 games back in the Southwest, while the unbeaten 6-0 Memphis Grizzlies, on a six-game winning streak, lead both the West and the Southwest. The Pelicans are without Jordan Poole (out, ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Dejounte Murray is day-to-day for personal reasons and a game-time decision. For Memphis, Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Pelicans winning the most recent meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
